## Newark launches Panasonic ERJPC Series: Thin-film precision in a thick-film footprint


November 5, 2026


[FAR 1224 Inline](https://news.avnet.com/files/images/newark/1920_far1224inline.jpg)


*Double Power Density enables smaller designs with accuracy down to 0.1% and 25ppm stability*


Newark is now selling the new ERJPC series of super high-precision thick-film resistors from Panasonic Industry. This innovative product line delivers precision levels previously only achievable with thin-film technology, offering engineers a powerful new tool for space constrained and high accuracy designs.


The ERJPC series delivers a TCR as low as 25ppm/K and tolerances down to ±0.1% and ±0.5%, allowing designers to achieve thin-film precision within a more cost-effective thick-film architecture. With up to double the power density of traditional thin-film solutions—0.2W in a 0603 size and 0.25W in 0805—designers can shrink their layouts by replacing larger components with smaller ERJPC resistors.


**Key Specifications Precision**


-


Tolerances of ±0.1% and ±0.5%


-


Stability: TCR down to 25ppm/K


-


Power Density: 0.2W (0603) and 0.25W (0805)


-


Reliability: AEC-Q200 compliant and RoHS certified


-


Applications: Battery Management Systems, Engine Control Units, Industrial Automation, and Consumer Electronics


**Clara Lagomarsini, Product Manager Device Solution Business Division at Panasonic Indust** r **y** explains: “Many applications - such as Battery Management Systems (BMS), Electronic Control Units (ECUs), home appliances and industrial and factory automation systems - require high precision components. Our thick film technology is a real alternative to thin film implementations. The new ERJPC thick-film series combine high-precision, environmental stability, while offering a new path towards long-term cost efficiency.”


**Andy Weatherill, VP Global Product, Supply Chain, Newark,** said: “Adding ERJPC to our Panasonic portfolio gives customers a high‑precision solution. By using advanced materials and optimized structures, Panasonic enables engineers to achieve thin‑film‑level accuracy alongside the power‑density advantages of thick‑film technology — supporting meaningful board downsizing and long‑term cost savings in demanding designs.”


The Panasonic ERJPC Super High-Precision Thick-Film Resistor series is available for fast delivery from


[Newark](https://www.newark.com/sc/panasonic/npi-erjpc) in North America,


[Farnell](https://uk.farnell.com/sc/panasonic/npi-erjpc) in EMEA, and


[element14](https://sg.element14.com/sc/panasonic/npi-erjpc) in APAC.
